result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, though the markings are significantly faded. The presence of streetcar tracks and degraded pavement surfaces introduces additional hazards for pedestrians and cyclists.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are worn and faded, reducing visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement and Tracks
hazards.description: Cracked pavement and embedded tracks create uneven surfaces that are tripping hazards for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility 'continental' style crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide roadway with integrated trolley tracks and significantly degraded pavement. There is a notable absence of marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals at this complex intersection, creating high exposure for people crossing the street.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Steel tracks embedded in the roadway create significant trip hazards and can be slippery for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground, running through the intersection

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt around the tracks and intersection increases the risk of falls.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path across a wide street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

result.summary: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite the presence of overhead traffic lights. The roadway features trolley tracks and significantly degraded pavement, which presents tripping hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at this signalized intersection, providing no designated space for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt around the trolley tracks creates a significant tripping hazard.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle signals but no pedestrian-specific walk/don't-walk indicators.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve crossing safety and predictability.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair the roadway surface, particularly around the trolley tracks, to eliminate tripping hazards.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of dedicated crossing infrastructure at a signalized intersection, with no marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals visible. The presence of trolley tracks and degraded pavement further complicates safe movement for people walking or using mobility devices.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks any marked crosswalks for pedestrians, increasing exposure risk.

hazards.name: Trolley Tracks
hazards.description: Exposed metal tracks in the roadway create a slip hazard and can catch bicycle tires or mobility aid wheels.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt near the tracks and intersection creates tripping hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signal infrastructure.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.
